Audio.Meaning: PowerShell mixes simulation packets. Interactive playback continues active music/effects through producer gaps. Caught-up packets apply every control/event in order without repeating intervals already covered by filler; new sounds start on the current output clock, and past audible output is not reconstructed. Headless/test playback remains packet-exact. Submission ages exclude compensated packets; processing ages include every consumed packet. Neither measures audible output. Queue starvation is polling, not hardware telemetry. Normal unpaused exit drains submitted device buffers for up to 250 ms; paused/error exits cancel the remaining tail and report its upper bound.

RetainedIntermediateHarnessFailure.Meaning: Initial worker already compensated 130/131 packet intervals. The old harness expected twenty submission-age samples; credited packets do not submit separate PCM. Test now measures all packet-processing ages and checks timing-credit/driver conservation, rather than treating absence of submission samples as recovery failure.

Meaning: PowerShell realtime output accounts for already-played filler intervals and applies caught-up controls/events in order on the current output clock. Late sounds cannot be reconstructed at past times; successive emitter replacements may coalesce before the next output block. A pending final effect gets one fresh block before explicit drain. Epoch, volume reset and music Start/Stop clear credits. Packet-exact non-realtime audio remains verified by independent PCM tests. Baseline submission ages include mixing; final processing ages precede the next current-clock output block and exclude device/acoustic tail. Controlled results are not clean loaded-route, physical input, acoustic or full campaign qualification.
